title: Aureline M5 write-target review
description: Canonical per-domain write-target review for a managed or captured-snapshot object. Names the object class, its owning-source association, the exact write target, whether a request-approval / restore review is required before any mutation, the nearest safe action, and the preserved-versus-lost sync note so a constrained write is never a silent lossy fallback. Downstream tab chrome, editor banners, diff / review headers, write-review sheets, AI / automation paths, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a class's write-target review by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
